designRules: Every MVP block and item must have an acquisition path, gameplay role, player use, progression stage, and runtime parity note.
Openlands Standard stays relaxed: food, shelter, and farming entries must avoid hardcore upkeep pressure.
Echo IDs remain the source of truth across Native, Standalone, and NeoForge adapters.
firstHourPromise: Openlands extends the Foundation first-hour route with the first waystone milestone.
roadmapDefaultRule: Openlands Standard remains the relaxed default through MVP, Public Alpha, 1.0, and later updates.
